Sandbox_AACS_AllowFaction: Allow faction members to be granted access
Sandbox_AACS_AllowFaction_tooltip: Enables faction-based sharing in the adoption manager.
Sandbox_AACS_AllowSafehouse: Allow safehouse members to be granted access
Sandbox_AACS_AllowSafehouse_tooltip: Enables safehouse-based sharing in the adoption manager.
Sandbox_AACS_AdminBypass_tooltip: Admins can manage or interact with any adopted animal.
Sandbox_AACS_RequireDocumentToAdopt_tool: Players must have a DocumentPet item to adopt.
Sandbox_AACS_ReturnDocumentOnUnadopt_too: Returns a DocumentPet when an adoption is removed (only if it was consumed).
Sandbox_AACS_MaxAdoptedAnimalsPerPlayer: Max adopted animals per player (0 = unlimited)
Sandbox_AACS_MaxAdoptedAnimalsPerPlayer_: Blocks adoption when a player reaches this limit.
Sandbox_AACS_DefaultPickupMode_tooltip: Initial pickup permission for newly adopted animals.
Sandbox_AACS_DefaultLeashMode_tooltip: Initial rope/leash permission for newly adopted animals.
Sandbox_AACS_VerboseLogs_tooltip: Prints extra debug output to the console/logs.
Sandbox_AACS_AdoptionExpiryDays: Adoption expiry (days without logging in; 0 = disabled)
Sandbox_AACS_AdoptionExpiryDays_tooltip: Releases adoptions after this many days without the owner's login.
